feeds.title: Southern Curls & Pearls
feeds.description: The blog is a source of inspiration for feminine, fun, and approachable style where Caitlin documents her day-to-day life as a creative outlet to express her love for fashion, beauty, healthy eating, fitness, and life in general.

feeds.title: Style Charade
feeds.description: Jennifer Lake is a Chicago blogger covering fashion, travel, home design, beauty, and lifestyle. Colorful style mixed with street art and murals. In 2015, she launched Style Charade as a small corner of the Internet to call her own. After spending her career helping others build their brands, she wanted a space that felt representative of the lens through which she seen the world.

feeds.title: Carly » style
feeds.description: Hi!! I'm Carly. I started this blog as a creative outlet during my freshman year at Georgetown University. In this blog, I share a little bit of life, a little bit of style, and a little bit of everything in between.

feeds.title: Kendi Everyday
feeds.description: Kendi Everyday is a every girl's guide to living your best life. Started in 2009 as a daily style blog, Kendi Everyday has quickly evolved into daily inspiration for style, beauty, lifestyle and entrepreneurship from editor Kendi Skeen.

feeds.title: Lemon Stripes
feeds.description: Lemon Stripes is a one-stop shop for readers who want to live a happy, healthy and fashionable life.

feeds.title: Sweet Southern Prep
feeds.description: Hi, I am Ashley. Launched in 2010, Sweet Southern Prep continues to be an outlet to share my love of fashion and family.

feeds.title: Midlifechic » Style
feeds.description: Midlife Chic is a UK blog for women over 40 who are getting their groove back. Written by the former editor of Selfridges magazine, it focuses on classic chic featuring high street fashion and beauty. It is a forum for midlife women to discuss the issues that they face as they enter into the second half of their life.

feeds.title: A Key to the Armoire
feeds.description: Hi, I am Susana. I love the artistry of fashion. My style is classic, built slowly through vintage and classic pieces. My staples are rooted in the 40s and 50s: foulards, twin sets, pearls, and anything that makes me feel feminine.

feeds.title: Tall and Preppy
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Elisabeth and welcome to Tall and Preppy! I know that classic and preppy pieces are what look the best and always work for me. I have created this blog to document my style throughout my life and to show others how a tall and preppy girl dresses!

feeds.title: The SK Way » Style
feeds.description: The SK Way is a classic and preppy lifestyle & style blog by Shannon Kirk, offering seasonal outfit inspiration, wardrobe essentials, and fashion guides to help women cultivate timeless, everyday looks.

feeds.title: Classy Girls Wear Pearls
feeds.description: Classy Girls Wear Pearls by Sarah Vickers is a Fashion and Lifestyle blog where she showcases her brand's lifestyle shoots, everyday outfits, travel, New England Living, home inspiration, and also her family life. EXplore exquisite outfits, accessory collections and fashion advice in these articles.

feeds.title: The Teacher Diva
feeds.description: Ashley started The Teacher Diva to express her creativity and love for all things fashion. Today, she works full-time on it to bring her readers the latest inspiration in fashion, travel, lifestyle, and home decor. When she is not working, she's spending time with her husband, and family or volunteering at her local elementary school. Check out her blog and learn more about fashion, beauty, lifestyle, and more.

feeds.title: Rachel Parcell, Inc.
feeds.description: Rachel Parcell is a women's clothing brand specializing in feminine and timeless pieces that will be worn time and time again. Check out different and unique outfits here on Rach Parcell.

feeds.title: Bows & Sequins
feeds.description: Hi there! My name is Jessica Sturdy and I'm a twenty-something currently living in the Gold Coast in Chicago. Bows & Sequins is a fashion-focused lifestyle blog where you'll find posts about my personal style and current sartorial inspirations.

feeds.title: Preppy Fashionist
feeds.description: Preppy Fashionist is a preppy fashion blog by Virgit Canaz.

feeds.title: Kelly in the City » Style
feeds.description: My name is Kelly Larkin, and this blog is where I document my life. While you'll find a whole lot of fashion-related content on Kelly in the City, my hope is that when you visit the site, you'll also get to know me as a person, and learn what's truly important to me.

feeds.title: Covering the Bases Blog
feeds.description: Launched in 2013, Covering the Bases is a New York lifestyle blog and a community of readers who want to live their happiest life by working hard, dressing well and traveling often.

feeds.title: The Preppy MAG
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Marie Goldstein and I am the Editor-In-Chief of ThePreppyMAG! This blog chronicles both my own style and the lifestyle of a total prepster.

feeds.title: Let's Get Preppy
feeds.description: Let's Get Preppy is a dose of my personal style as well as lifestyle tips and tricks for high school students. It encompasses my love for the color pink and shares my enthusiasm for all things preppy.

feeds.title: Preppy On My Style
feeds.description: Preppy On My Style is a Fashion and Lifestyle Blog.

feeds.title: A Preppy Brunette
feeds.description: Hey y'all! As a preppy college girl, I've taken my passion for writing and created this blog. I defiantly love the 'preppy' classic style and try to embody it everyday in my wardrobe.

feeds.title: preppy style by mira
feeds.description: Hey y'all! My name is Mirabella Grace. I love to blog and write, and I'm so excited for y'all to read preppy style by mira! If y'all didn't know my blog is mostly lifestyle, with hints on preppy style, organization, lists and ideas!

feeds.title: Preppy by the Sea
feeds.description: Hi we are Catherine and Julianna and both of us love preppy fashion.We have learned more about blogging than we ever thought we would and are thankful for all the memories and opportunities we have gained from being Preppy by the Sea.

feeds.title: AshLee Frazier
feeds.description: My name is AshLee Frazier. AshLee Frazier is a fashion and lifestyle blog where I share all the things in my life I was born to love.

feeds.title: Style ElixirStyle Elixir
feeds.description: Sparkle and inspiration to live your best life! Style Elixir is a leading beauty, lifestyle and fashion blog by Lauren Slade. Discover all things fabulous!

feeds.title: Cashmere & Jeans
feeds.description: A Coastal Inspired Home & Preppy Fashion Blog Based in Michigan

feeds.title: Gal Meets Glam
feeds.description: A Charleston Based Style and Beauty Blog by Julia Engel
